newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cheuvreux turns buyer on GAN. [CORRECTED 14:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cheuvreux turns buyer on GAN. [CORRECTED 14:55 GMT]

text.p: Brokers Cheuvreux-de Virieu changed its recommendation on French insurer Groupe des Assurance Nationales (GAN) on Friday to buy (note 2) from sell (note 3), fund managers said.
The government announced a state rescue package of up to 20 billion francs on Thursday to shore up the company's accounts after 35 billion francs of losses since 1992.

GAN shares were suspended limit up at 149.1 (corrects from 123) francs for an open-ended period on Friday morning after several attempts to requote were abandoned as the price repeatedly breached limits triggering a halt in trading.
The Paris bourse would only requote GAN if the share price stayed under a ceiling of 149.10 francs, the SBF stock markets association said.
